59 names · #2 025~048 · 064~098 · pack `motion2` · Languages: [日本語](README.ja.md) / [简体中文](README.zh-Hans.md)

## Transitions & highlights

| # | Name | What it is | How to ask an AI |
|---|---|---|---|
| [#2-041](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#2-041) | **Push transition** | The next scene pushes the current one out | Go to the next slide with a push transition from the right, 0.8 s. |
| [#2-042](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#2-042) | **Blinds transition** | The next scene opens through thin strips | Change scenes with a blinds transition: seven horizontal strips that open over 1 s. |

| [#2-044](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#2-044) | **Page curl** | Peels back like paper to show the next page | Go to the next chapter with a page curl from the bottom-right corner, 1.2 s. |
| [#2-045](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#2-045) | **Pixelate** | Turns into coarse blocks, then switches | Use a pixelate transition: the mosaic gets coarser over 0.6 s and the scene changes at the coarsest point. |
| [#2-046](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#2-046) | **Shatter** | Breaks like glass and the shards fly off | Before the title appears, break the previous scene with a shatter: cracks first, then the shards fall away in about 1 s. |

| [#2-048](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#2-048) | **Split screen** | Divides the frame to show scenes side by side | Show three scenes at once with a split screen: from one panel to two, then three, 0.5 s each. |
